problem: Which of the following is an upper triangular matrix?

examples.problem:
Which of the following matrices are lower triangular matrices?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14075464/assets/ad9636de9b8c93338350a6b99d88476b481ed1bf03a5dd64935abedbdb626524.png)
examples.worked_solution:
The matrix $B$ is a lower triangular matrix since all the entries above the main diagonal are zeros.

The matrices $A$ and $C$ are *not* lower triangular matrices since they each have a non-zero element above the main diagonal:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{23} & =1\ne 0 \\ {c}_{13} & =1\ne 0\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix? 

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that $C$ is a matrix for which all entries below the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, it is an upper triangular matrix.

It is not a lower triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element above the diagonal: ${c}_{12}=1\ne 0.$
